ex.en: They have no impact on the environment.
ex.zh: 它們對環境完全沒有影響。

ex.en: The blizzard has already had a severe impact on the economy.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雪已經對經濟造成嚴重衝擊。

ex.en: This incident has made a great impact on the progress of the project.
ex.zh: 這起事件大大影響了專案進度。

ex.en: Rising costs will impact our profits.
ex.zh: 成本上升會影響我們的獲利。

ex.en: The new policy impacted thousands of workers.
ex.zh: 新政策影響了數千名員工。

ex.en: The car was badly damaged on impact.
ex.zh: 汽車在撞擊時嚴重受損。

ex.en: The phone case protects against impact.
ex.zh: 這個手機殼可以防撞。

ex.en: It is imperative for you to act at once.
ex.zh: 你必須立刻採取行動。

ex.en: It is imperative for you to finish by Sunday.
ex.zh: 你一定要在星期日前完成。

ex.en: It is imperative that we meet the deadline.
ex.zh: 我們務必要趕上截止期限。

ex.en: The longer we waited, the more impatient we became.
ex.zh: 我們等得越久，就越不耐煩。

ex.en: I think Tom is a bit too impatient.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆有點太沒耐心了。

ex.en: The kids are impatient to open their presents.
ex.zh: 孩子們迫不及待想拆禮物。

ex.en: She was impatient to start her new job.
ex.zh: 她迫不及待想開始新工作。

ex.en: He has a hearing impairment.
ex.zh: 他有聽力障礙。

ex.en: Lack of sleep can cause memory impairment.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會造成記憶力受損。

ex.en: The company recorded an impairment loss on the old factory.
ex.zh: 公司就舊工廠認列了減損損失。

ex.en: The auditors asked about the asset impairment.
ex.zh: 會計師詢問了資產減損的情況。

implicit.zh: 暗示的、含蓄的、不言而喻的

ex.en: There was an implicit criticism in his comment.
ex.zh: 他的話裡隱含著批評。

ex.en: Her silence was an implicit agreement.
ex.zh: 她的沉默等於默許。

ex.en: I have implicit trust in my team.
ex.zh: 我完全信任我的團隊。

ex.en: She has implicit faith in her doctor.
ex.zh: 她對她的醫生深信不疑。

ex.en: The rules must be few and, more importantly, simple.
ex.zh: 規則要少，更重要的是要簡單。

ex.en: She's beautiful, smart, and - most importantly - has a good heart.
ex.zh: 她漂亮、聰明，而且最重要的是心地善良。

ex.en: One needs to do their best in all things, and more importantly work within their abilities.
ex.zh: 凡事要盡力而為，更重要的是要量力而行。

ex.en: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
ex.zh: 現在大家都對天花免疫了。

ex.en: The immune system protects the body from disease.
ex.zh: 免疫系統保護身體不受疾病侵害。

ex.en: No company is immune to an economic crisis.
ex.zh: 沒有一家公司能不受經濟危機影響。

ex.en: He seems immune to criticism.
ex.zh: 他似乎對批評無動於衷。

ex.en: There is an imbalance between supply and demand.
ex.zh: 供需之間失衡。

ex.en: A trade imbalance can hurt the economy.
ex.zh: 貿易失衡可能會傷害經濟。

imminent.zh: 即將發生的、迫在眉睫的

ex.en: A decision on the merger is imminent.
ex.zh: 合併案即將做出決定。

ex.en: Dark clouds warned that a storm was imminent.
ex.zh: 烏雲預示暴風雨即將來臨。

impair.zh: 損害、削弱、影響（能力、功能）

ex.en: Lack of sleep can impair your judgment.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足會影響你的判斷力。

ex.en: Drinking alcohol impairs your ability to drive.
ex.zh: 喝酒會削弱你的駕駛能力。

ex.en: The app is designed for people with impaired vision.
ex.zh: 這個 App 是為視力受損的人設計的。

ex.en: We are the largest importer of coffee in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 我們是台灣最大的咖啡進口商。

ex.en: The importer must pay duties on the goods.
ex.zh: 進口商必須為這批貨支付關稅。

ex.en: Honesty was the most important factor in his success.
ex.zh: 誠實是他成功最重要的因素。

ex.en: Breakfast is the most important meal of the day.
ex.zh: 早飯是一天中最重要的一頓飯。

ex.en: It is important for him to get the job.
ex.zh: 得到那份工作對他來說很重要。

ex.en: I would like to improve my English pronunciation.
ex.zh: 我想改善我的英文發音。

ex.en: We are always looking for ways to improve our service.
ex.zh: 我們一直在尋找改善服務的方法。

ex.en: Tom's Japanese is improving little by little.
ex.zh: 湯姆的日文一點一點在進步。

ex.en: With her help, my French improved little by little.
ex.zh: 在她的幫助下，我的法文慢慢進步了。

ex.en: It has greatly improved compared with what it was.
ex.zh: 和以前相比，已經進步很多了。

ex.en: Today no one can imagine a life without television.
ex.zh: 現在沒有人能想像沒有電視的生活。

ex.en: He is not like the person I imagined.
ex.zh: 他跟我想像中的人不一樣。

ex.en: Imagine working from a beach in Bali.
ex.zh: 想像一下在峇里島的海灘上工作。

ex.en: I foolishly imagined that he was going to help me.
ex.zh: 我傻傻地以為他會幫我。

ex.en: I imagine you must be tired after the flight.
ex.zh: 我想你搭完飛機一定很累吧。

ex.en: It is necessary for you to go there immediately.
ex.zh: 你必須馬上去那裡。

ex.en: We took action immediately so that things wouldn't get worse.
ex.zh: 為了避免情況惡化，我們立刻採取了行動。

ex.en: He commanded me to leave the room immediately.
ex.zh: 他命令我立刻離開這個房間。

ex.en: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
ex.zh: 他強調教育的重要性。

ex.en: I didn't realize the importance of that problem.
ex.zh: 我沒意識到那個問題的重要性。

ex.en: This is a matter of the utmost importance.
ex.zh: 這件事至關重要。

ex.en: We've made a lot of improvements today.
ex.zh: 我們今天有了很多進步。

ex.en: Actually, the present method has plenty of room for improvement.
ex.zh: 其實目前的方法還有很大的改善空間。

ex.en: Your essay still needs some improvement.
ex.zh: 你的論文還需要一些改進。

ex.en: It's impossible for me to explain it to you.
ex.zh: 我不可能解釋給你聽。

ex.en: Finishing the report by tomorrow is next to impossible.
ex.zh: 明天之前完成報告幾乎是不可能的。

ex.en: It is impossible to master English in a short time.
ex.zh: 不可能在短時間內精通英語。

ex.en: My first impression of him proved to be correct.
ex.zh: 我對他的第一印象果然沒錯。

ex.en: What you said left a deep impression on me.
ex.zh: 你說的話讓我印象非常深刻。

ex.en: That day left a deep impression on me.
ex.zh: 那一天讓我印象很深刻。

impression.zh: be under the impression that：以為、誤以為

ex.en: I was under the impression that the meeting was canceled.
ex.zh: 我原本以為會議取消了。

ex.en: She was under the impression that Tom was single.
ex.zh: 她一直以為湯姆是單身。

ex.en: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
ex.zh: 我們應該盡量避免把自己的信念強加在別人身上。

ex.en: He always imposes his opinion on me.
ex.zh: 他總是把他的看法強加給我。

ex.en: The government imposed a new tax on imported cars.
ex.zh: 政府對進口車課徵新稅。

ex.en: The city imposed strict rules on parking.
ex.zh: 市政府對停車實施嚴格規定。

ex.en: I don't want to impose on you.
ex.zh: 我不想給你添麻煩。

ex.en: Are you sure I'm not imposing?
ex.zh: 你確定我不會打擾到你嗎？

ex.en: They needed to make a decision - an immediate decision.
ex.zh: 他們需要做決定，而且是立刻做決定。

ex.en: His speech won the immediate applause of the audience.
ex.zh: 他的演講立刻贏得了觀眾的掌聲。

ex.en: The new policy will take immediate effect.
ex.zh: 新政策將立即生效。

immediate.zh: 直接的；最接近的（如直屬主管、直系親屬）

ex.en: Please report any problems to your immediate supervisor.
ex.zh: 有任何問題請向你的直屬主管報告。

ex.en: Only immediate family members attended the wedding.
ex.zh: 只有直系親屬參加了婚禮。

ex.en: None of them could understand what she was implying.
ex.zh: 他們沒有人聽得懂她在暗示什麼。

ex.en: Are you implying that I'm too young?
ex.zh: 你是在暗示我太年輕嗎？

ex.en: I didn't mean to imply otherwise.
ex.zh: 我沒有要暗示別的意思。

ex.en: A good education doesn't imply a good upbringing.
ex.zh: 受過良好教育不代表有良好的教養。

ex.en: A higher price doesn't necessarily imply better quality.
ex.zh: 價格較高不一定代表品質較好。

ex.en: This will have enormous implications for Algeria.
ex.zh: 這將對阿爾及利亞產生重大影響。

ex.en: We need to consider the implications of this decision.
ex.zh: 我們必須考慮這個決定可能帶來的影響。

ex.en: The implication was that where there was a well, there were residents.
ex.zh: 言下之意是，有水井的地方就有人居住。

ex.en: By implication, he was blaming his manager.
ex.zh: 他的話暗指是主管的錯。

ex.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
ex.zh: 演講者精彩的演說讓我們印象深刻。

ex.en: Tom's designs didn't impress me much.
ex.zh: 湯姆的設計沒讓我覺得有多厲害。

ex.en: I couldn't help but be impressed by Tom's courage.
ex.zh: 湯姆的勇氣讓我不得不佩服。

impressive.zh: 令人印象深刻的、出色的

ex.en: I find her very impressive.
ex.zh: 我覺得她很令人佩服。

ex.en: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
ex.zh: 你們兩個今天都表現得很出色。我以你們為傲。

ex.en: The company's growth this year is impressive.
ex.zh: 公司今年的成長令人印象深刻。

ex.en: We are encouraged to use our imagination.
ex.zh: 我們被鼓勵發揮想像力。

ex.en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
ex.zh: 想像力影響著我們生活的各個方面。

ex.en: I want you to use your imagination.
ex.zh: 我希望你發揮自己的想像力。

ex.en: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
ex.zh: 這超出了我的想像。

ex.en: Don't worry, it's just your imagination.
ex.zh: 別擔心，那只是你的想像。

ex.en: Many of the immigrants changed their names.
ex.zh: 許多移民改了名字。

ex.en: Most Americans are descended from immigrants.
ex.zh: 大多數美國人都是移民的後代。

ex.en: America is a land of immigrants.
ex.zh: 美國是一個移民國家。

ex.en: The implementation of the new system will take six months.
ex.zh: 新系統的導入需要六個月。

ex.en: We are in charge of the policy's implementation.
ex.zh: 我們負責這項政策的執行。

ex.en: Careful planning is key to successful implementation.
ex.zh: 周詳的規劃是成功執行的關鍵。

ex.en: She thought the plan was fine but impractical.
ex.zh: 她覺得這個計畫很好，但不可行。

ex.en: We all consider your idea to be impractical.
ex.zh: 我們都認為你的想法行不通。

ex.en: High heels are impractical for a long walking tour.
ex.zh: 穿高跟鞋參加長時間的徒步導覽並不實際。

imposing.zh: 雄偉的、壯觀的；令人印象深刻的

ex.en: The bank's head office is an imposing building.
ex.zh: 那家銀行的總部是一棟雄偉的建築。

ex.en: He is an imposing figure in the industry.
ex.zh: 他是業界舉足輕重的人物。

ex.en: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
ex.zh: 他叫太太不要衝動購物。

ex.en: I felt an impulse to cry out loud.
ex.zh: 我突然有股想大叫的衝動。

ex.en: Sharks are sensitive to electrical impulses as well as sound.
ex.zh: 鯊魚對電訊號和聲音都很敏感。

ex.en: Nerves send electrical impulses to the brain.
ex.zh: 神經把電訊號傳到大腦。

ex.en: You guys in America can impeach your president too.
ex.zh: 你們美國人也可以彈劾總統啊。

ex.en: The president was impeached but not removed from office.
ex.zh: 總統遭到彈劾，但沒有被免職。

ex.en: We import tea from India.
ex.zh: 我們從印度進口茶葉。

ex.en: Imported cars account for less than eight percent.
ex.zh: 進口車只占不到 8%。

ex.en: The imports from Asian countries have expanded recently.
ex.zh: 最近從亞洲國家的進口量不斷擴大。

ex.en: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.
ex.zh: 他想降低進口稅。

ex.en: The Shanghainese people must build up Shanghai's new image.
ex.zh: 上海人必須建立上海的新形象。

ex.en: The company is trying to improve its image.
ex.zh: 這家公司正努力改善形象。

ex.en: Images and videos are transformed into gifs and memes.
ex.zh: 影像和影片被轉換為GIF和哏。

ex.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
ex.zh: 選擇合適的衛星圖做為底圖。

ex.en: The contract talks reached an impasse.
ex.zh: 合約協商陷入僵局。

ex.en: Both sides proposed a review to resolve the impasse.
ex.zh: 雙方提議重新檢視，以化解僵局。

ex.en: Please let me see your passport, also did you complete the immigration form?
ex.zh: 請出示護照。入境表格填好了嗎？

ex.en: The line at immigration was very long.
ex.zh: 入境審查的隊伍排得很長。

ex.en: The government is changing its immigration policy.
ex.zh: 政府正在修改移民政策。

ex.en: Immigration has changed the city over the past 50 years.
ex.zh: 過去五十年來，移民改變了這座城市。

ex.en: Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
ex.zh: 很多公司實施每天八小時工作制。

ex.en: Our company will implement new price standards regarding this product.
ex.zh: 針對這項產品，本公司將實施新的價格標準。

ex.en: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
ex.zh: 公司下個月開始推行新的管理制度。
